_note: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning hybrid Mamba-2 + MoE + Attention (30B-A3B). BF16 reference weights. Up to 1M ctx; 262144 on single H100 (memory-bound).
_note_serve: Per the NVIDIA model card / vLLM recipe (vllm/vllm-openai:v0.27.1+, repo serves 0.28.0 which satisfies): --reasoning-parser nemotron_v3 (vLLM; SGLang uses nemotron_3) --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --enable-auto-tool-choice, plus Mamba-specific flags (--mamba-backend flashinfer --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float16 --enable-mamba-cache-stochastic-rounding --mamba-cache-philox-rounds 5).
_note_context: Served window (max_model_len) is 262144 -- sized to fit a single 80GB H100 in BF16 (the card's validated single-GPU context). Native max_position_embeddings is 1M; serving 1M needs TP8 + expert parallelism. Pass MAX_MODEL_LEN=262144 explicitly; the sbatch default is 131072.
